source: Minds production study population forecasts (30 forecast points per question), exported 2026-11-23. Individual written replies were not collected in this run (collection was on demand).
question_label: How much do you agree with this statement? (0 to 10)

four-day-workweek.question: How much do you agree with this statement: I am in favor of a four-day workweek. Answer on a scale from 0 (strongly disagree) to 10 (strongly agree).

rto-executive-control.question: How much do you agree with this statement: Return-to-office requirements are more about executive control than boosting productivity. Answer on a scale from 0 (strongly disagree) to 10 (strongly agree).

cut-back-dining-out.question: How much do you agree with this statement: I have cut back on dining out. Answer on a scale from 0 (strongly disagree) to 10 (strongly agree).

ai-more-opportunities.question: How much do you agree with this statement: AI will create more opportunities than it eliminates in my industry. Answer on a scale from 0 (strongly disagree) to 10 (strongly agree).

salary-sharing.question: How much do you agree with this statement: I am comfortable sharing my salary with my coworkers. Answer on a scale from 0 (strongly disagree) to 10 (strongly agree).

genai-regular-use.question: How much do you agree with this statement: I currently use generative AI regularly in my day-to-day work. Answer on a scale from 0 (strongly disagree) to 10 (strongly agree).
